svg.title: Tech stack
svg.desc: An isometric mechanical keyboard whose keys are the tools Hugo uses: TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Go, C, C++, R, PHP, HTML5, CSS, Markdown; Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, Vite, Sass, Three.js, GSAP, p5.js, Chart.js, Bootstrap, Chakra UI; PostgreSQL, Neon, Redis, Node.js, Express, Git, GitHub, npm, RStudio, Electron, OVH; Figma, Photoshop, Lightroom, Premiere Pro, Blender, Dribbble, WordPress, Webflow.
